import_contract.dimensions: persist only the explicitly verified dimension names and statements from the result
import_contract.idempotence: refuse execution if any selected project-owner assessment or manual projection already exists; never overwrite

gate_assessment.mode: offline and read-only after the committed import
must_report: prospective decided-label count and positive/negative split
exact prediction compatibility for every imported decided label
whether the protocol's 40-label, eight-family, both-class, and two-wave conditions pass
gate_assessment.interpretation: The import satisfies the family, prediction-wave, and both-class conditions but leaves the cohort at 39 decided prospective labels. OPT-003 remains open and data-gated by one decided label; later evidence, promotion, closure, or branch merge requires separate authorization.

stop_conditions: Any result, packet, store, finding, feature, prediction, cohort, or usage-ledger precondition differs from the frozen value.
Any response would require interpretation, correction, additional source evidence, or a disposition not already explicit in the result.
Any selected finding already has the project-owner assessment or manual label projection covered by this receipt.
The import cannot complete as one atomic transaction or any expected row count differs before commit.
Any abstention would create a label, any decided response would receive the wrong binary projection, or any rationale or dimension would drift.
